name: testing-best-practices
title_zh: 测试先问删掉哪条才心疼的 Laravel 测试评审
tagline_zh: 选覆盖、起名字、挑断言、隔离依赖、测 HTTP 与安全边界——它不替你写码，专治「测了等于没测」的假绿。
tagline_en: Picks coverage, names tests, isolates deps, checks HTTP/security edges—kills false greens that pass but prove.
desc_en: Laravel test design and review. Use when selecting coverage, naming or structuring tests, choosing assertions or test data, isolating dependencies, testing HTTP or security boundaries, improving suite performance, or reviewing test value. Use framework guidance or search-docs for Pest and PHPUnit syntax.
why_zh: 先判测试价值再谈语法：每个建议都指向「删掉它你怕不怕」，逼你留下真正兜底的用例，而非凑行数。
why_en: Judges test worth before syntax—every tip asks 'would you fear deleting this?' so you keep only real safety nets.
limit_zh: 只评审 Laravel/PHP 测试设计与结构，不生成测试代码；Pest/PHPUnit 具体语法需另配官方文档。
limit_en: Reviews Laravel/PHP test design only; writes no code. Pest/PHPUnit syntax needs official docs. No frontend/non-PHP. Refactor advice stops at plan.
title_en: Laravel test review that asks which test you'd delete
